newsitem.title: ITALY: Italy coffee roasters say new price rises certain.
newsitem.headline: Italy coffee roasters say new price rises certain.

text.p: Italian coffee roasters are poised to hike retail prices in the near future following two increases in quick succession in February as they struggle to keep up with the rise in world coffee prices.
"The way the market is moving a third price increase is going to be unavoidable," said a marketing executive at a major Italian coffee roaster who asked that neither he nor his company be identified.
The roaster had made two increases of seven percent and nine percent respectively in February.
"Raising prices is very tough, especially now that inflation is so low. Distributors find it hard to accept," he added.
Most roasters had hiked their prices in recent weeks although some companies had managed not to pass on increases onto consumers, he said.
A buyer at coffee roaster Luigi Lavazza Spa said he expected some consumers to react to higher arabica prices by purchasing blends with a higher proportion of robusta.
Arabica coffee normally accounts for more than 50 percent of Italian blends.
"There have to be price increases," said the buyer, adding that the recent strengthening of the dollar had raised the cost of imports into Italy by some 15 percent.
